_schema.description: Suggested line-up for the new site, built from the Etsy shop. One row per design: near-duplicate Etsy listings are grouped, every listing appears exactly once. A RECOMMENDATION for the owner to rule on in decisions.json. Nothing here is acted upon automatically. Produced by scripts/lineup-draft.mjs.
_schema.ranking: Rows are ranked by the best member's num_favorers, then views. These are lifetime PROXIES for demand. Real per-listing sales need Etsy OAuth (transactions_r), which this export does not use.
_schema.tiers: core = top 20% of designs; keep = next 40%; review = bottom 40% with 5+ favourites; cut-candidate = bottom 40% under 5 favourites.
